Below is a quick‑look list of the **long weekends** that Canadians (federal holidays) will enjoy in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a natural 3‑day break from Saturday to Sunday.)

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Long Weekend? | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| Jan 1 2023 | New Year’s Day | Sunday | ❌ | Holiday, but no natural long weekend |
| Feb 20 2023 | Family Day (Ontario) | Monday | ✅ | Creates Sat Feb 18–Sun Feb 19 |
| Apr 7 2023 | Good Friday | Friday | ✅ | Creates Fri Apr 7–Sun Apr 9 |
| May 22 2023 | Victoria Day | Monday | ✅ | Creates Sat May 20–Sun May 21 |
| Jul 1 2023 | Canada Day | Saturday | ❌ | Holiday, but no natural long weekend |
| Aug 7 2023 | Civic Holiday (Ontario, BC, etc.) | Monday | ✅ | Creates Sat Aug 5–Sun Aug 6 |
| Sep 4 2023 | Labour Day | Monday | ✅ | Creates Sat Sep 2–Sun Sep 3 |
| Oct 9 2023 | Thanksgiving | Monday | ✅ | Creates Sat Oct 7–Sun Oct 8 |
| Nov 11 2023 | Remembrance Day | Saturday | ❌ | Holiday, but no natural long weekend |
| Dec 25 2023 | Christmas Day | Monday | ✅ | Creates Sat Dec 23–Sun Dec 24 |
| Dec 26 2023 | Boxing Day | Tuesday | ❌ | Holiday, but no natural long weekend |

### Quick Summary

- **Long weekends (3 days)**: Family Day (Ontario), Good Friday, Victoria Day, Civic Holiday (Ontario/BC/etc.), Labour Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas Day.  
- **Other holidays**: New Year’s Day, Canada Day, Remembrance Day, Boxing Day – these are public holidays but do not automatically give you a 3‑day weekend unless you take an extra day off.

> **Tip for your app**: If you want to support province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, etc.), you’ll need to add those dates separately. The table above covers the federal holidays that create long weekends across Canada in 2023.
